$comment: Brass Knuckles Knock Out (docs/brass-knuckles-design.md), pinned for every port:
Read by ios/Sources/MorseKitCheck/main.swift and the Android and desktop
Every expected value comes from the game's own reference implementation,
pocketcw-logic 0.4.0 (logic/src/boxing.rs, rng.rs, ticks.rs by Derick KO6PBZ, for the HamCube
PocketCW firmware by Kristen K5MME; GPL-3.0-or-later), run on a seed and a script, not
from any of our ports. The generator is fixtures/brass-knuckles-oracle.rs. Do not
regenerate this file to make a failing test pass; regenerate it only when the rules are
meant to change, and say so in the commit.

derivation.ladder: [name, from, blurb, koch, speedBump, spacingPct, hint, noise, fading, maxTell, hp, power, reactMs, restLeastMs, restExtraMs, openMs, pitchOffsetHz, fist] for each of the eight fighters, in order.
derivation.speeds: [fighter, baseWpm, farnsworth, characterWpm, effectiveWpm]: Fighter.speeds(base, farnsworth).
derivation.characters: [character, punch, units, damageGood, damageOff, damageBad] for the 41 Koch characters in order. punch is jab (all dits), hook (all dahs) or comboN (N runs, at most 4). units is the ideal length in dots with no trailing gap. noPunch has no code and throws nothing.
derivation.rng: xorshift32, seed | 1. below(n) is the next state mod n. Three sequences, and the US calls us_call builds from the same generator (call area digit k % 10).
derivation.tellsAndWords: For each fighter: 12 tells drawn from a fight seeded 12345, and 10 uppercut words from a fight seeded 777 (callsign K5MME), all with weights at their default of 8.
derivation.career: [fighter, won, score, opensNext, unlockedAfter, bestScoreAfter, winsAfter] after each finished fight in order, on a fresh career.
derivation.worst: FightStats.worst after K right twice, M wrong once, R right once and wrong once: worst first.
derivation.fights: Each fight starts at tick 1000 and runs 'ops' in order; after every op 'expect' has one snapshot line. Ops: start, startFalse (start must be refused), advance (jump to the deadline and update; nothing if none), update dt, wait dt, tellPlayed dt, answer quality dt (key the whole tell), key char quality dt, keyUnknown dt, getUp quality dt, star dt, word quality dt, pause dt, resume dt, setFoeHp n, setMyHp n, setStars n. dt is milliseconds added to the clock before the op. After each op the pending play (take_play) and judged copies (take_copies) are taken and appended. Snapshot: phase|duel|hp foe me|st stars run cleanRun|sc score|rd round|now|dl deadline|tell|ans|word|typed|cnt|up getUp|play|stats tells,dodged,punches,clean,damage,taken,uppercuts,knockdowns,knocked|foe pose|me pose|call callout|stop|copies sent+copied (_ = missed).

ladder: CALLS CQ ON TOP OF EVERYONE
SHE SPLATTERS AND SHE KNOWS IT
NO AMP, NO HINTS, NO MERCY
HERE ONE SECOND, GONE THE NEXT
A KEY CUT FROM A HACKSAW BLADE
THE LEGAL LIMIT IS A SUGGESTION
